text:
leila_pm: Quick async Q2 OKR check — routing milestone status please. Need a one-line owner + shipped/slipped + blocker by EOD Wednesday so I can fold into the OKR doc.

sam_eng: Shipped: canary rollout to 50% ✅ — owner: @sam_eng. Notes: observed ~8% p50 latency bump during synthetic load, digging in.

matt_infra: Slipped: autoscale policies and e2e tests — owner: @matt_infra. Blocker: router-agent isn't emitting the scaling metric (see PR #412). PR is WIP, ETA Fri.

ana_prod: Shipped: routing rules UI (staging) — owner: @ana_prod. UX looks good, will hold the toggle until infra is green.

devon_sre: Observability: confirmed KV cache metrics missing. Following PR #412. Proposal: temporary fallback to single-variant routing during peak windows if autoscale fails.

sam_eng: Repro note: KV cache thrash on prefix-miss spikes causes CPU jitter. Working on mitigations: 1) short-term cache-size bump, 2) backpressure on ingestion.

matt_infra: PR snippet for autoscaler config:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  target_util: 0.75
  max_replicas: 20
  metrics_source: router-agent
```
Need SRE sign-off and final target numbers from @leila_pm.

leila_pm: Decision for now — hold canary at 50% until autoscale tests pass. @matt_infra add a clear test plan to the PR and tag SRE. @ana_prod keep the UI toggle disabled.

ana_prod: Roger. Toggle is in staging and disabled. Will not flip without a green from infra/SRE.

devon_sre: I can run a focused load test tomorrow 09:00 PT and validate p95/p99 and token/sec cost delta. Ping me when PR is ready.

sam_eng: Next actions (one-liners):
- @matt_infra: finish PR + add e2e tests (ETA: Fri)
- @devon_sre: run load test (tom 09:00 PT)
- @sam_eng: add extra KV/caching metrics to instrument (today)
- @ana_prod: hold UI flag; prep PM communication

leila_pm: Fallback plan if autoscale doesn't land: route new signups to backup instance pool and delay full rollout by 7 days. @deploy-bot please log rollout hold.

deploy-bot: NOTE logged: rollout-hold (ticket INF-2309) — canary traffic frozen at 50%.

leila_pm: Thanks — please update this thread with short status lines only. I'll synthesize for the OKR doc later.
